question: India created history by winning which of the following cup titles for the first time in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thomas Cup**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India clinched the prestigious **Thomas Cup** for the first time in May 2022.
 
• The Indian men's badminton team defeated the 14-time champion **Indonesia** to win the title.
 
• This historic victory was achieved with a 3-0 scoreline in the final match.
 
• The Thomas Cup is considered one of the most prestigious team events in international badminton.
 
• Key players such as **Kidambi Srikanth** and **Lakshya Sen** played crucial roles in securing the win.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thomas Cup**

 
 
• The Thomas Cup, also known as the World Men's Team Championships, is a biennial badminton tournament.
 
• It was first held in 1949 and is organized by the Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
• The tournament is named after Sir George Thomas, an English badminton player and administrator.
 
• It features teams from various countries competing in a knockout format.
 
 
 
• **Kidambi Srikanth**
 
 
• He is an Indian badminton player who has been ranked as high as World No. 1 in the BWF rankings.
 
• Srikanth played a crucial role in India's victory in the Thomas Cup 2022.
 
• He has won multiple international titles, including the 2017 Indonesia Open and the 2017 Australian Open.
 
 
 
• **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**
 
 
• The BWF is the international governing body for the sport of badminton, recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• It was founded in 1934 and is responsible for overseeing the sport's global development and organizing major tournaments.
 
• The BWF is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
 
 
 
• **Indonesia in Thomas Cup**
 
 
• Indonesia is one of the most successful nations in the history of the Thomas Cup, having won the title 14 times.
 
• The team has produced numerous world-class players over the years.
 
• Indonesia's defeat to India in the 2022 final was a significant upset.
